messages:
maria: Quick contract Q — finalizing the prompt/prefix cache key format and the cache-hit header semantics. Need to keep this backward compatible with current clients. Proposal: key = sha256(model + '|' + canonicalized_prompt_prefix + '|' + canonical_sorted_params). Header = X-Redwood-Prompt-Cache: hit|miss|partial. Also expose optional X-Redwood-Cache-Key for debugging behind a flag. Thoughts? @kevin @sanjay :thinking:

kevin: Two quick flags — (1) avoid including raw prompt text in any header or logs (PII risk). Hash only. (2) if we rename the header we should emit the old x-cache-hit for at least one release as an alias. :+1:

sanjay: Agree on hash. For the params part, use canonical JSON with sorted keys, and include stable serialization for floats/ints. Also we need rules for prefix length bins (e.g., if prefix is >1024 chars, truncate then hash) so keys stay bounded. Regarding invalidation: add POST /cache/invalidate with body { key: "<key-or-prefix>", prefix: true|false, origin: "deployment|admin" } and document eventual consistency.

devops-bot: Deploy scheduled: cache-keying-v2 -> staging @ 2024-11-09T14:00Z :rocket:

nia: Quick practical question — streaming clients: will the cache header be available for streamed responses? Right now headers are finalized at end; streaming libs may not see them. Suggest adding an early header `x-cache-decision: pending|hit-candidate` and final `x-cache-hit` in response trailers when supported. For HTTP/1.1 fallback, include the decision in the initial headers and final status in logs.

kevin: Nice catch. Implementation options: (A) emit an initial `X-Redwood-Cache-Decision` with metadata about prefix-only matches, then emit `X-Redwood-Prompt-Cache: hit|partial|miss` in trailers. Need to confirm http/2 + trailers lib support. Also think about a `reason` token for debugging: e.g., `X-Redwood-Cache-Reason: prefix-match|kv-hit|stale|evicted` but that's more verbose.

maria: I pushed a draft PR (link in thread) with proto, docs, and sample responses. Key points in PR: code sample for canonicalization, header names: `X-Redwood-Prompt-Cache: hit|miss|partial`, legacy `X-Cache-Hit` is preserved for one release, optional `X-Redwood-Cache-Key` emitted only when `debug=true` and caller is org-admin. Also added /cache/invalidate endpoint that accepts prefix=true for bulk invalidation. Could someone skim the contract docs and call out compatibility risks? Ping @kevin for code review.

kevin: :eyes: I'll review the PR today. One security nit: leaking full cache keys even as debug may be surprising; let's mask middle bytes or only provide a short hex prefix. Also add unit test to ensure `Cache-Control: no-store` bypasses cache.

sanjay: Add metrics names in the docs: `prompt_cache.hit`, `prompt_cache.miss`, `prompt_cache.partial`, `prompt_cache.eviction_reason`. Also add SLO notes: when we return partial hits we should record latency and token-savings separately. For invalidation, document that prefix invalidation is eventually consistent and may take up to X minutes depending on replication; include a TTL-expiry flow.

maria: Plan suggestion: merge docs + tests behind feature flag, stage rollout to small tenants, keep legacy header for min 4 weeks, then remove alias after upgrade window. Invalidation endpoint to be GA with flag for org-admins. If everyone OK I'll schedule the rollout and add the masking change kevin suggested. :thumbsup:

kevin: LGTM. I'll add tests and the masking change. Will also confirm trailer support on our client SDKs.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the PR with the masking rule and rollout steps. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed. :smile:
